adjudications.subject: claim:array-expressions-native-ordered
adjudications.claimText: Array creations inside expressions convert to native Calor with C# evaluation order kept (once, left to right, short-circuit preserved); new forms (inline §ARR2D with §ROW, sized §ARR2D for rank 3+, (§IDX2D g i j).Member); jagged and rectangular forms keep type and rank; new T[0] and { } create fresh arrays (#1132).
rowLimitations: F5 READY on d1d7afde (9 of 9). F5-ARRAY-01, 05 and X-INT-02 are native under approved reading R-PERMISSIVE-EFFECTS-NATIVE (only Calor0410 without --permissive-effects).

adjudications.subject: claim:generated-names-avoid-collisions
adjudications.claimText: Generated names (_hoist000, arr2d004) skip every identifier in the source and in a project migration's other files.

adjudications.subject: claim:array-shapes-stay-csharp-reported
adjudications.claimText: Shapes that cannot be written in place stay C# and are reported (conditional-expression-hoisting, array-element-block), including collection-initializer and multi-line elements.

adjudications.subject: claim:arr2d-row-effects-charged
adjudications.claimText: Elements of §ARR2D rows are charged for effects; array members such as GetLength and Rank on array-typed receivers remain unknown calls (Calor0410 unless declared or --permissive-effects), except System.Array receivers and manifest-defaulted element namespaces.

adjudications.subject: claim:trusted-publishing
adjudications.claimText: NuGet publishing uses nuget.org Trusted Publishing; no NuGet API key is stored in GitHub; the policy requires the main-only nuget-release environment, so an older tag's workflow cannot obtain a key; on 2026-10-19 the live check reported the gap closed, with Actions workflow permissions confirmed by maintainer attestation.
rowLimitations: The live check cannot see nuget.org itself (manifest open item NUGET-POLICY-NOT-VISIBLE).

adjudications.subject: claim:notes-hash-checked-g014
adjudications.claimText: On every run the gate checks that the candidate's notes section hashes to the adjudicated notes (G014).
rowLimitations: This record's release-notes hash is c20087ec..., the render of the candidate's section; the R2 run for this record passed G014.

adjudications.subject: claim:benchmark-publication-separate-g015
adjudications.claimText: Publishing a release does not publish benchmark results; that needs a separate manual run and an approval in the acceptance record (G015).
rowLimitations: This record does not approve benchmark publication (approved: false).

adjudications.subject: claim:release-sdk-pin-no-google-fonts
adjudications.claimText: Release jobs install exactly .NET SDK 10.0.401, and the website no longer fetches fonts from Google Fonts at build time.
rowLimitations: The website tree built byte-identically in two fresh clones and two Linux CI builds (treeSha256 92b7d44e...).

adjudications.subject: claim:release-runtime-pinned
adjudications.claimText: Release jobs run the C# compiler on the SDK's own runtime (10.0.12), remove any newer 10.0 runtime and fail if one remains, because the runtime version changed package bytes.
rowLimitations: Packages and metadata were byte-identical across macOS clones A and B and Linux CI run 39516192814 (two builds).

benchmark-results.note: Not approved. 0.25.0 publishes no new benchmark results (notes line 40). The two #1422 output hashes are listed because the R2 schema requires them (G011); without approved: true, G015 refuses publication.
